tiers.name: Tier 1: Lexical String Matching (BLEU / ROUGE-L / Naive Regex Exact Match)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 1: 传统字面字符串匹配 (BLEU / ROUGE-L / 简单正则完全匹配)
tiers.judge_mechanism: N-gram surface overlap + raw string equality without AST/SymPy normalization

tiers.name: Tier 2: Naive Single-Pass Frontier API Judge (Unconstrained 1-10 Score / Single-Order Pairwise)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 2: 单次直评商业大模型裁判 (无量表 1~10 打分 / 单向 A-vs-B 盲评)
tiers.judge_mechanism: Single API call (GPT-4o) asking 'Which response is better?' without position swap or length control

tiers.name: Tier 3: Position-Swapped Bidirectional Rubric Judge (Self-Hosted Prometheus-2 / JudgeLM + Length De-Biasing)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 3: 双向位置交换 + 原子量表校准专属裁判 (自建 Prometheus-2 + 长度去偏回归)
tiers.judge_mechanism: Dual-order (A,B)+(B,A) consistency gate + 5-point atomic reference rubric + AlpacaEval GLM length control

tiers.name: Tier 4: Hybrid Execution-Verified Sandbox (RLVR) + Step-Level PRM + Debiased Rubric Judge
tiers.name_zh: Tier 4: 确定性执行沙箱验证器 (RLVR) + 步骤级过程奖励 (PRM) + 双向去偏量表裁判
tiers.judge_mechanism: Isolated Wasm/Container Unit-Test + SymPy/SQL AST Equivalence Verifier (70% tasks) + PRM + Bidirectional Rubric (30% open tasks)

adversarial_judge_perturbations.attack_type: Position Swap: (A, B) vs (B, A) on Equal-Quality Answers
Verbosity Stuffing: Wrong Answer Padded with +300 Words of Markdown Tables
Sycophancy / Format Spoofing: 'Sure! Here is a comprehensive expert analysis:' + Subtle Bug
Math/Code Surface Variation: '0.5' vs '\frac{1}{2}' or Refactored Variable Names
